stories.title: UK recycled-content packaging up 17% since plastic tax began
stories.summary: HMRC data shows plastic packaging meeting the UK's 30% recycled-content threshold is 17% higher in 2025–26 compared to when the Plastic Packaging Tax launched, while taxable plastic packaging fell 21%. The figures indicate the tax is incentivising industry to shift to more recycled materials.

stories.title: New rules enable digital proof of age for alcohol sales
stories.summary: The Home Office and DCMS announced new licensing rules allowing businesses in England and Wales to accept certified digital ID apps as proof of age when purchasing alcohol, replacing the need to carry physical documents like passports or driving licences.

stories.title: 'Signs of violence': asylum seekers deported from UK arrive in France injured
stories.summary: Asylum seekers removed from the UK under the government's returns scheme arrived in France with injuries, raising serious concerns from advocacy groups about treatment during deportation. The incident has prompted calls for an independent investigation.

stories.title: Young Brits recruited as drug mules as overseas arrests quadruple in three years
stories.summary: The FCDO warned that criminal gangs are increasingly targeting young British nationals to carry drugs abroad, with overseas drug smuggling arrests quadrupling over three years. Minister Stephen Doughty MP urged travellers to be vigilant.

stories.title: UK steps up support for El Niño preparedness following devastating extreme weather
stories.summary: The FCDO announced increased UK support for global efforts to prepare for El Niño weather events, following devastating extreme weather impacting vulnerable nations. Minister Kirsty McNeill MP outlined the UK's contribution to international resilience programmes.

stories.title: Minister for International Development speech at New Economics Foundation
stories.summary: Minister Kirsty McNeill MP delivered a speech at the New Economics Foundation, setting out the UK's approach to international development and economic growth in partnership with developing nations.

stories.title: Adult Skills Fund: updated funding rules published
stories.summary: DWP published updated guidance and funding rules for the Adult Skills Fund, setting out eligibility and funding conditions for further education providers as part of the government's wider effort to improve skills and employment outcomes.

stories.title: Environment Secretary backs British farming on Back British Farming Day
stories.summary: Environment Secretary Angela Eagle spoke in support of British farming, emphasising the government's commitment to food security, climate resilience, and sustainable agricultural practices, describing farming as a 'national security priority' alongside energy and defence.

stories.title: DEFRA's 25-year roadmap gives private finance a bigger role in farm support
stories.summary: DEFRA's long-term agricultural support roadmap envisions a greater role for private finance beyond 2026, with Sustainable Farming Incentive agreements capped at £100,000 per farm, reduced from 102 to 71 actions, and shortened to three years.

stories.title: Government moves to acquire Speciality Steel UK
stories.summary: BIST announced the government's decision to acquire Speciality Steel UK in a significant industrial intervention to protect a strategically important part of the UK's steel sector. Secretaries of State Louise Haigh and Jonathan Reynolds confirmed the move.

stories.title: UK and US co-chair Global Fusion Policy Summit; joint statement on fusion energy issued
stories.summary: UK Minister for Energy Michael Shanks co-chaired an international fusion energy summit with US Under Secretary for Science Darío Gil, bringing together global partners and issuing a joint statement affirming shared commitments to fusion as a future clean energy source.

stories.title: 50+ UK organisations back charter for paid family leave for women in research
stories.summary: More than 50 UK organisations backed a new charter to deliver paid family leave and flexible working support for women in research, representing a commitment to improving gender equity in science and innovation sectors.

stories.title: Palantir publicity 'could harm NHS research', health minister claims
stories.summary: A BMJ report reveals a health minister raised concerns that high-profile publicity around Palantir's NHS data contract could discourage patient participation in research, with 8% of 40–69 year olds already opting out of data sharing amid public debate.

stories.title: L-plates and safety warnings proposed for AI tools in healthcare
stories.summary: Healthcare technology experts are calling for clearer safety frameworks for AI in NHS settings, including tiered safety requirements and warning labels for AI diagnostic and clinical decision tools as adoption accelerates across the health service.

stories.title: South Tyneside and Sunderland NHS Trust ranks among best performers for patient throughput
stories.summary: More patients are being seen faster at South Tyneside and Sunderland NHS Foundation Trust, which ranks among the NHS's top performers according to latest performance data, as national NHS waiting lists continue to fall.

stories.title: Royal Mail delivery delays continue across Peterborough and 100+ UK postcodes
stories.summary: Thousands of households in Peterborough and surrounding areas continue to be affected by Royal Mail delivery delays in mid-September, with storms and staff absences causing disruptions across more than 100 UK postcodes.
